title: Calibrating Behavioral Parameters with Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM decision-making through fully synthetic financial scenarios (e.g., gamble acceptance, portfolio rebalancing, forecasting) using profile-based prompts. The study calculates specific parameters for eight canonical biases (loss aversion, disposition effect, overconfidence, herding, representativeness, probability weighting, anchoring, and extrapolation) and compares them against quantitative human benchmarks.

Measuring the baseline, unprompted behavior of LLMs in financial decision-making scenarios to document their systematic deviation toward normatively correct (rational) reasoning relative to observed human baselines.
